author: Forbes
description:
How did Nissan save $34 million while making its factory floors safer? Nissan North America's Division VP Victor Taylor explains how the company uses "Invisible AI" to monitor assembly line ergonomics and prevent employee injuries. Learn how Nissan overcame AI apprehension through community education, why they view AI as an enhancement rather than a replacement tool, and how they balance governance with creativity to scale AI successfully.
